exchanges: so tonight was weird, really quiet ward for once which never happens and honestly it made me more nervous than a busy one
Quiet nights can feel eerie when you are used to chaos.
tariq was on with me and we just sat at the station doing paperwork and eating biscuits
Not a bad way to spend a calm shift.
his little boy Idris drew him a card with a giant ambulance on it and he showed everyone like four times
That is very sweet.

hana just banged on the wall lol
Sounds like she is not a fan of the morning concert.
shes half Czech and says in prague nobody would play music this loud before noon, which i doubt

probably true lol. arjun is coming over later, we have to finalise wedding stuff

she keeps texting me pictures of maternity dresses

dalhousie is nicer anyway it has the big lawn
